title: ilang.ai: the iLang protocol website and its agent-readable layer
description: Source of the official iLang website at ilang.ai, published on Cloudflare Pages. It carries the protocol pages (specification, dictionary, playground, benchmark, conformance, ecosystem and the comparisons with MCP, A2A and GibberLink), the blog, and the machine-readable layer the site serves to AI agents: llms.txt and llms-full.txt, Markdown negotiation on every page, an OpenAPI document, a JSON schema directory, an API catalog, robots and sitemap files, and the /.well-known discovery records. Readme in eleven languages. MIT licensed.
